defs.def: a long complicated piece of music for a large orchestra, in three or four main parts (called movements ) 交响乐；交响曲adj.

ex.s: Kind regards, Diana Memorable moments Like a musical symphony, life has high and low moments, and somewhere in between are those moments we call “bittersweet”.
ex.t: 此致，戴安娜 难忘的时刻 如同音乐交响曲，生活有高潮也有低谷，而在两者之间，是我们称之为“苦乐参半”的时刻。

ex.s: Everyoneknowsthat LudwigvanBeethoven isamusical geniusbutfewmightknowhowhe created Symphony No.
ex.t: 人人都知道路德维希·凡·贝多芬是一位音乐天才，但很少有人知道他是如何创作出……交响曲的。

ex.s: Inspired by his struggles with deafness, the composer produced some amazing pieces, including nine 10S symphonies, five piano pieces, and an opera!
ex.t: 受他与耳聋抗争的启发，这位作曲家创作了一些惊人的作品，包括九部交响曲、五首钢琴曲和一部歌剧！

ex.s: He proceeded with the composition until his death in 1827,writing more than 130 musical works, including his Symphony No.
ex.t: 他一直创作到1827年去世，写下了130多部音乐作品，包括他的第……号交响曲。

ex.s: One day in February 1824,at his little house in Vienna, Austria, Ludwig van 15 Beethovensat back in his chair and smiled.Thefamous German composer's ninth symphony was finally completed.
ex.t: 1824年2月的一天，在奥地利维也纳他的小屋里，路德维希·凡·贝多芬靠在椅背上笑了。这位著名的德国作曲家的第九交响曲终于完成了。
